about: E47 claim_tests (reports/plans/2026-10-28_plan_claim-tests.md): five $0 MATS-cluster debug jobs, one per red-teamed claim (reports/reviews/2026-10-29_review_claims-red-team.md). Card L40. Filed before any run and before the code is written; the code must refuse to start without this file.

common.card: NVIDIA L40 (MATS cluster debug QoS); the card is recorded and the lines come from the same job's floor
common.rows: Pile val rows 0-255, two blocks of 128 (faithfulness.pile_blocks), the same rows for every state and start
common.starts: h<k> = faithfulness.pile_faithfulness(model, blocks, seed=k)['pgd_kl'] (20 steps of 0.1); budget = mean over blocks of gamma.pgd_sources(model, block, 20, step_size=0.1, seed=0)[1] (E34 Amendments 4-5's start, bf16 readout)
common.ratio: ratio_s = KL(state, start s) / KL(W0, start s), W0 read in the same job on the same rows; relative
common.R_max: max over the state's starts of ratio_s; R_mean = mean over the starts (T2 only)
common.f: W0's PGD floor = max/min - 1 of W0's KL over the harness starts read in the job (faith_score.seed_floor); expected 0.2088 (L40 jobs 40166, 40195, 40497)
common.verdict: faith_score.verdict(r, f, 1.5): pass if r <= 1.5/(1+f), fail if r >= 1.5*(1+f), else inconclusive; expected lines 1.241 / 1.813. A tie on a line goes to that line's side
common.stop_at: a do-nothing or cell state stops reading after the first start whose ratio is >= the fail line; its verdict is then fail (a max can only rise) and its mean is not computed
common.missing_start: a start that errors or returns a non-finite value leaves the state unscored unless it already failed; an unscored state never counts as pass
common.C0: first, alone, every job: W0 at every start the job reads. Stop if faith_score.w0_check fails (seed-0 PGD within 10% of 0.69, CI within 2% of 0.348, f <= 0.25) or if the budget start's W0 KL / h0's W0 KL is outside [0.85, 1.15] (E34 Amendment 5: 2.4% on the H100). W0's own ratio is 1 at every start by construction

predictions.claim: (i) teacher-trained decompositions pass the adversarial check where do-nothing fails

states.r1_nothing: r1 SGD teacher (run.Job.teacher: SGD 0.03, 1000 steps, seed 0) left in Delta; positive control
states.r1_copy: saved teacher_training/results/large/r1_t534_v369/amend5_A_sgd_seed0_step1000.pt on the regenerated r1 SGD teacher
states.rand32_nothing: E42 rand32 teacher (newskill.py recipe) left in Delta
states.rand32_copy: saved teacher_training/results/large/e42/rand32/A_step1000.pt on the regenerated rand32 teacher

predictions.rule: stands: both copies pass on R_max, both do-nothing states fail on R_max, and for each teacher copy R_max * (1+f) < do-nothing R_max. falls: either copy's R_max fails. no_power_<teacher>: both copies pass and that teacher's do-nothing does not fail (the claim then stands only for the other teacher). Anything else (a copy inconclusive or unscored): unsettled

expected.r1_copy: 1.0-1.15 (H100 1.00 at h0; A4 copies 0.95-1.15 at the budget start)

predictions.lean: stands for r1, no power on rand32; low (rand32's do-nothing has never been read at the budget start)
predictions.blind_to: other tasks and fine-tune seeds; arm B and seed-1 copies; harness start h2; 160-step budgets and other adversary families; behaviour (not re-read; the copies' P was filed in E34/E42)
predictions.positive_control: r1_nothing at the budget start must read >= the fail line; else stop (the budget branch is broken or card-dependent)
predictions.noise_floor: W0 start spread f = 0.209 on the L40 (one start); per-block W0 spread up to 40% at h1 (block 1 1.0007 vs 0.716)
predictions.edges: tie on a line goes to that line's side; early stop on a do-nothing state is a final fail; a copy with a missing start makes the stage unsettled; W0 cannot cross a line (ratio 1); f > 0.25 stops at C0

predictions.claim: (ii) the rank-8 LoRA's teacher-trained decomposition passes, and the pass does not need the rank cap

states.adam_tt: saved broad_fragility/results/large/trained_step1000.pt on the regenerated Adam fine-tune (run.py: Adam 3e-5, 300 steps, seed 0; gain 0.1301 +- 0.005); positive control, h0 only
states.lora8_tt: saved broad_fragility/results/large/a2_tt_lora_s0.pt on the regenerated rank-8 LoRA (amend2.lora_delta seed 0, lr 1e-4, 300 steps; gain 0.1479 +- 0.005)
states.lora128_tt: new: rank-128 LoRA with the same recipe, then E37's teacher training (Adam 1e-5, batch 8, 1000 steps, order 0); offsets saved as bf16 and read back from bf16 like the saved states

predictions.rule: statistic R_mean over h0, h1. absolute: lora8_tt pass -> stands; fail -> falls (not real); inconclusive -> unsettled on this card. cap: lora128_tt fail while lora8_tt does not fail -> cap artefact; R_mean(lora128_tt) <= R_mean(lora8_tt) * (1+f) -> no cap effect up to rank 128; else unsettled. If adam_tt does not read fail at h0, the cap reading is unscored (no power) and the lead is told; the job continues

expected.lora8_tt: 1.2-1.3 (H100 1.27), so likely inconclusive under the L40 lines
expected.lora128_tt: real: about rank 8's; cap artefact: towards 2.2

predictions.lean: absolute unsettled on the L40; no cap effect; low
predictions.blind_to: rank 32; LoRA seed 1; the second row set (val 256-511); the SGD states; the budget start; whether a higher-rank LoRA's larger gain confounds the rank (the gain is reported, not matched)
predictions.noise_floor: f = 0.209 (L40, rows 0-255); E39's block contrast (LoRA 1.11 / 1.42 per block, H100)
predictions.edges: tie on a line goes to that line's side; a missing start leaves the state unscored and its branch unsettled; if lora8_tt itself fails, the cap branch is unscored (nothing to climb from)

predictions.claim: (iii) the scaled adjoint split's keep falls with the update's size, not its path (the adversarial half is settled from the JSON: E22 SGD at size 0.0122 passes at 0.98, Adam at 0.0113 fails at 2.52)
predictions.recipe: r1_t534_v369 windows; adjoint_sgd/run.py finetune (arm A, plain SGD), seeds 0 and 1; size = largest relative matrix change (rel_norm_max); keep = P(target) of split.adjoint_state(dW) / P(target) at W0 + dW, on the held-out windows

parts.a: SGD 0.03 checkpointed at the step whose size is nearest the 0.01 run's step-100 and step-1000 sizes (pass 1 records size every step to 400; pass 2 reruns to those steps); matched within 5%
parts.b: the 0.01 run's step-1000 dW scaled by alpha = size10/size1000 and size100/size1000 (about 0.24, 0.57); c is scale-invariant, so only size changes; alpha = 1 is the positive control (keep 0.13)

predictions.rule: per seed. size_stands: |keep(a) - keep(0.01 at the same size)| <= 0.05 at both sizes AND keep(b, alpha) >= keep(0.01 at the matching step) - 0.05 at both alphas. size_falls: |keep(a) - keep(0.01)| > 0.10 at either size OR keep(b) <= keep(0.01, step 1000) + 0.07 at both alphas. else mixed. Stage: the seed-level outcome if both seeds agree, else mixed

expected.path_reading: a: 0.03 keeps more at matched size (E31 hint 0.25 vs 0.13); b: about 0.13

predictions.lean: size falls (path or direction matters); medium
predictions.blind_to: the adversarial check (not read); other tasks and Adam; c's own drift (b holds it fixed by construction); keep's nonlinearity in P (scaling shrinks the numerator and the denominator together)
predictions.noise_floor: keep's seed-to-seed spread for r1 SGD 0.01: 0.015 / 0.027 / 0.004 at steps 10/100/1000; cross-card P within 0.02 (E42 G1 tolerance)
predictions.edges: a size not matched within 5% leaves that cell unscored; a denominator P < 0.5 leaves that cell unscored; an unscored cell makes its part unscored for that seed and the stage mixed at best; seeds that disagree give mixed

predictions.claim: (iv) E43: teacher training plus remainder reads worse than do-nothing

states.nothing: emoticon Adam 3e-5 arm-A fine-tune, seed 0, step 1000 (remainder.py recipe), left in Delta; the reference
states.plus_remainder: that fine-tune's teacher training (arm A, Adam 1e-5, order 0, 1000 steps) with target W0 + dW (Delta' = Delta + W_ft - W_tt)

predictions.gates: G1: fine-tune P within 0.02 of 0.99961 and size within 5% of 0.03209; G3: teacher-trained P within 0.02 of 0.99675, Delta share <= 1e-6; G2: removal reproduces the copy's dW to 1e-3; any miss: stop
predictions.rule: q_s = KL(plus_remainder, s) / KL(nothing, s). stands: min_s ratio(plus_remainder) > max_s ratio(nothing) AND q_s >= 1.1 at all three starts. falls: q_s <= 1.0 at any start. else unsettled (worse at every start, inside the start spread). No early stop; any missing start leaves the stage unscored
predictions.lean: unsettled; low (E43's margin sat in one 128-row block)
predictions.blind_to: step 10; other tasks, seeds and batch orders; the budget start; the stochastic ratio (equal in E43)
predictions.positive_control: none beyond C0 and the gates; h0 is the reproduction of E43's ordering
predictions.noise_floor: f = 0.209 (L40, rows 0-255); W0 block-2 spread over seeds 0-2 20% (H100)
predictions.edges: KL(nothing, s) <= 0 is impossible above W0's ~0.7 nats but would leave q_s unscored; a tie at q_s = 1.0 counts as falls; a tie between ranges counts as overlap (not stands)

predictions.claim: (v) teacher training with plain SGD fails on r1's Adam and LoRA teachers
predictions.teachers: amend6.py: r1 Adam 3e-5 ft_teacher (seed 0, 1000 steps; P 0.9962 +- 0.02) and amend3.lora_teacher (rank 8; P 0.9992 +- 0.02)
predictions.student: arm S: plain SGD on the r1 task windows, batch 32, batch order 0 (amend6 student with s_lr varied)
predictions.positive_control: Adam teacher, rate 0.03, step 1000, read at h0 only: must read fail (H100 3.14); else stop
predictions.f_source: 0.2088 from the L40 jobs 40166/40195/40497 when this job's W0 h0 KL reproduces 0.69174 within 1e-3 relative; otherwise W0 is read at h1 in the job and f computed there
predictions.rule: a cell passes on a teacher if held-out P >= 0.9 and its R_max verdict over (budget, h0) is pass; cells with P < 0.9 are not read. stands: no cell passes on either teacher. falls: some cell passes on both teachers. mixed: some cell passes on exactly one teacher and none on both. unsettled: fewer than two cells per teacher have P >= 0.9, or an unscored cell could still make it falls

expected.c03_100: unknown; on r1's SGD teacher the same cell read 1.00 (H100); LoRA teacher's window damage at step 100 was 3.6x its teacher's

predictions.lean: falls (some early or slower SGD cell passes on both teachers); low
predictions.blind_to: rate 0.003; rate 0.03 at step 1000 on the LoRA teacher (known 2.86, H100); harness starts h1, h2; other tasks; momentum or schedules
predictions.edges: a tie on a line goes to that line's side; an early-stopped cell is a final fail; a cell unread for P < 0.9 counts as not pass; all cells below P 0.9 gives unsettled, not stands

amendment_1.about: Amendment 1 (user decision 2026-10-29): the pieces cut from T1, T2, T4 and T5 run as extra 30-minute debug jobs (plan section 'Amendment 1'). Filed before any E47 job ran; the keys above are unchanged. Every job reads C0 first and alone at its own starts and rows (common.C0, with the per-start references of experiments/claim_tests/job.py Config: rows 0-255 PGD 0.69 / 0.8362 / 0.7049 at h0 / h1 / h2, CI 0.348; rows 256-511 PGD 0.6298 at h0 only, CI 0.3331, broad_fragility Amendment 2 on the H100; filing fix 2026-10-29 before any run: no h1/h2 reference there, since the L40 reads h1 11% above the H100 on rows 0-255), then its parent's positive control, then its states. f with a single harness start: 0.2088 when W0 reproduces its L40 KL at that start within 1e-3 relative, otherwise one more harness start is read in the job and f taken over the two (T5's rule, extended)

predictions.claim: (i), the cut start: T1's four states at harness start h2
predictions.states: as T1 (r1_nothing, r1_copy, rand32_nothing, rand32_copy), the teachers regenerated in-job by T1's recipes and gates
predictions.positive_control: T1's, as filed: r1_nothing read at the budget start (state control_budget; W0 read at the budget start in C0 for it) must read >= the fail line; else stop. The states are then read at h2 (r1_nothing again at h2 for the combination). Filing fix 2026-10-29, before any run: replaces a first wording that read the control at h2 with a 'not pass' rule
predictions.rule: t1b alone: T1's rule on h2 (reported). Combined T1 (the verdict of claim (i)): T1's rule on R_max over {budget, h0, h1} from job t1 and {h2} from job t1b, each ratio over its own job's W0 at that start; f = max/min - 1 of W0's KL over every harness start read in the two jobs (h0, h1, h2; expected 0.2088). A state is unscored if a start is missing or non-finite in either job, unless some finite ratio already reaches the fail line (a final fail)

expected.r1_nothing: about 1.5-1.8 at h2 (E34 1.588 at h0 on the H100); inconclusive alone, so the combined fail comes from the budget start

predictions.lean: combined T1 as T1's lean (stands for r1, no power on rand32); h2 changes no verdict (low)
predictions.edges: a tie on a line goes to that line's side; T1's early stop at the budget start stays a final fail in the combination; a copy unscored in either job makes the combination unsettled; f > 0.25 stops at C0; t1b reads one harness start, so f there is the L40 value or a second start read in-job

predictions.claim: (ii), the cut rank: does rank 32 climb where rank 8 does not

states.adam_tt: T2's positive control, h0 only (saved trained_step1000.pt)
states.lora8_tt: T2's rank-8 state, reread in this job (saved a2_tt_lora_s0.pt)
states.lora32_tt: new: rank-32 LoRA by T2's LoRA recipe (amend2.lora_delta at rank 32: Adam 1e-4, batch 8, 300 steps, LoRA seed 0), then E37's teacher training (Adam 1e-5, batch 8, 1000 steps, order 0); saved as bf16 offsets (results/large/t2_lora_r32_tt.pt) and read back from them

predictions.gates: as T2: the regenerated Adam and rank-8 fine-tunes' held-out gains within 0.005 of 0.1301 and 0.1479; stop otherwise
predictions.rule: R_mean over h0, h1. cap at rank 32: if adam_tt does not read fail at h0, unscored (no power, the job continues and the lead is told); if lora8_tt (this job) reads fail or is unscored, unscored; lora32_tt fail -> cap_artefact; R_mean(lora32_tt) <= R_mean(lora8_tt) * (1+f) -> no_cap_effect; else unsettled. lora8_tt's absolute reading is reported beside T2's (same rows, a repeat)

expected.lora32_tt: real: about rank 8's; cap artefact: towards 2.2

predictions.blind_to: ranks between 32 and 128; LoRA seed 1; the budget start; whether the rank-32 gain differs (reported, not matched)
predictions.edges: a tie on a line goes to that line's side; a missing start leaves the state unscored and the cap unscored; a rank-8 fail leaves the cap unscored (nothing to climb from)

predictions.claim: (ii) on the second row set: T2's states on Pile val rows 256-511
predictions.rows: Pile val rows 256-511, two blocks of 128 (batches of 8, as broad_fragility Amendment 2's rows2_context), the same rows for W0 and every state
predictions.f_source: this job's W0 on rows 256-511 at h0 and h1: f = max/min - 1 (faith_score.seed_floor, as faith_score.verdict's f); expected about 0.15 (the H100 read 0.044 over seeds 0-1, but the L40 reads h1 11% higher than the H100 on rows 0-255; filing fix 2026-10-29), not necessarily 0.2088. The lines are 1.5/(1+f) and 1.5*(1+f) from that f

predictions.rule: T2's rule on these rows with this f: absolute (lora8_tt R_mean pass -> stands, fail -> falls, else unsettled) and cap (lora128_tt fail while lora8_tt does not -> cap_artefact; R_mean(128) <= R_mean(8) * (1+f) -> no_cap_effect; else unsettled; unscored without the control's fail)
predictions.lean: absolute unsettled or stands (H100 rows2 read 1.21 'pass' at lines 1.40/1.61; a smaller f here tightens both lines); no cap effect (low)
predictions.blind_to: other row sets; the budget start; harness start h2
predictions.positive_control: adam_tt reads fail at h0 on these rows
predictions.noise_floor: f measured on these rows in the job (H100 0.062 over seeds 0-2, 0.044 over seeds 0-1)
predictions.edges: a tie goes to the line's side; f > 0.25 stops at C0; a missing start leaves the state unscored

predictions.claim: (v) at the cut rate: arm S at rate 0.003, step 1000, on r1's Adam and LoRA teachers
predictions.states: positive control (Adam teacher, arm S 0.03, step 1000, h0 only), then cell (0.003, step 1000) on the Adam teacher and on the LoRA teacher, each read with stop_at when its held-out P >= 0.9
predictions.positive_control: as T5: the control reads fail at h0 (H100 3.14); else stop

Combined T5 (the verdict of claim (v)): T5's rule over the three cells (0.03, 100), (0.01, 1000), (0.003, 1000), each cell's pass taken with its own job's f: falls if some cell passes on both teachers; else unsettled if fewer than two cells per teacher have P >= 0.9, or an unscored cell could still make it falls (its other teacher's cell passes or is unscored); else mixed if some cell passes on exactly one teacher; else stands

expected.c003_1000: unknown; smaller moves than 0.01's, so the likeliest pass if plain SGD learns at all (P may fall below 0.9)
